title: CUSUM-Shaped Inference-Time Monitoring and Targeted Re-Decoding for Quantized Small Language Model Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2607.20129v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Quantized small reasoning models can enter repetitive or otherwise unproductive trajectories, yet standard decoding does not adapt to the trajectory as it unfolds. We study MGT-B, a fixed, weight-preserving controller that converts overlapping windows of uncertainty, repetition, and local-change features into position-conditional empirical tail probabilities. It accumulates mixture betting factors with a CUSUM-shaped reset, and, after an alarm, restores a coherent earlier token and key-value-cache state before constrained re-decoding. On MATH-500, a paired three-seed evaluation over 1,500 generations per method raises exact-normalized accuracy from 54.73% for vanilla decoding to 56.40% (+1.67 percentage points; problem-clustered bootstrap 95% CI [+0.47, +2.80]), while a prospectively profiled random-intervention control reaches 54.60%. translated_title: 面向量化小型语言模型推理的CUSUM形态推理时监控与目标性重解码
translated_abstract: 量化小型推理模型可能进入重复或其他低效的推理轨迹，而标准解码方法无法在轨迹展开过程中进行自适应调整。我们研究了MGT-B，这是一个固定的、权重保持不变的控制器，它将不确定性、重复性和局部变化特征的重叠窗口转换为位置条件的经验尾部概率。该控制器以CUSUM形态的重置方式累积混合下注因子，在触发警报后，先恢复到较早的连贯token及键值缓存状态，随后进行受约束的重解码。在MATH-500上，一项针对每种方法各1,500次生成的配对三种子评估显示，精确归一化准确率从普通解码的54.73%提升至56.40%（+1.67个百分点；问题聚类bootstrap 95%置信区间[+0.47, +2.80]），而经前瞻性分析的随机干预对照组仅达到54.60%。该增益在全部三个种子中均为正值，代价是多采样5.14%的token。种子0的消融实验显示……
tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于CUSUM形态的推理时监控控制器MGT-B，能够检测量化小型语言模型推理中的重复或低效轨迹，并通过恢复较早的token和缓存状态进行目标性重解码，在MATH-500上将准确率提升1.67个百分点，且仅增加5.14%的采样token开销。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes MGT-B, a CUSUM-shaped inference-time monitoring controller that detects repetitive or unproductive trajectories in quantized small language model reasoning and performs targeted re-decoding by restoring earlier token and key-value-cache states, improving MATH-500 accuracy by 1.67 percentage points at a cost of only 5.14% more sampled tokens.
